## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Sevierville, United States. It starts at 2925 Parkway.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Crave Golf Club’s Rooftop Mini-Golf Course in Pigeon Forge offers 19 holes of adventure and fun as you golf your way through this two-tiered outdoor course. Multi-challenge holes give you more than one way to win as you putt through a fully handicap-accessible, candy-coated wonderland that tests the skill of all ages.
>
> Complete delightfully competitive environments like Rock Candy Mountain, Bubblegum Garden, and the Jellybean Jungle, filled with crystalline candy stalagmites, gumball trees, and giant lollipops. Watch out for the jellybean Crave-men! This exciting course winds its way from ground level, up a hill and then onto the roof. Get ready for the best outdoor mini-golf adventure ever. Crave’s indoor mini-golf Course weaves you through a dreamland of cliffs made of cocoa, ice cream sculpted canyons, and a safari that is sure to satisfy anyone’s sweet tooth. Use the Spin Zone to add more fun and increase the difficulty of your game.
